svg.title: Slim: model size
svg.desc: Slider-ring icon for the slimmable-model overlay. Derived from the sibling single-capture plug-in's SlimmableIcon.svg, recoloured to this panel's palette: the gold is kGold (0xB88B4C), the piping colour sampled from the faceplate art that edges the level meters, and the unfilled track is kTextColor (0xFFFFFF) - the gear beside it is white, and at this size kDimColor was a stub nobody could see.
